headline: Turn PDFs Into Audiobooks Through MCP
lede: A compact service links an OpenAI subscription to document processing, then hands speech generation to a separately billed API key. The workflow is practical, but its billing boundary and credential handling deserve a clear schematic.

headline: Rust Borrow Checker Bug Breaks Lifetime Guarantees
lede: A newly reported soundness flaw can move a stack reference into a context treated as static data. The issue affects current nightly releases and stable Rust versions back to at least 1.85.0.

headline: A Hittite Court Speaks From 131 Tablets
lede: Excavators at Samuha have recovered 131 cuneiform tablets and fragments from the reign of Tudhaliya II. Their records preserve the daily machinery of a royal court: illness, funerals, reinforcements, rituals, and divination.

headline: How One Cell Computes Its Way Toward Food
lede: E. coli senses chemical gradients, adjusts its flagellar motors, and remembers enough of its recent environment to keep adapting. Its chemotaxis system offers a measured case study in computation without a nervous system.

headline: Legal AI Moves From Drafting Toward Workflow
lede: GLM-Legal is built not merely to answer legal questions, but to review documents, track constraints, use tools, and produce work that can be checked. Its promise is lower-cost routine work; its unresolved problem is how errors, jurisdiction, and accountability travel through the pipeline.
pullquote: The real legal-AI test is not fluent drafting, but reviewable work under consequence.

headline: Intel Puts 480 GB Behind Inference
lede: Intel’s D270 is a 350-watt, inference-focused data-center GPU with up to 480 GB of LPDDR5X and support for familiar open-model software. The design targets memory-hungry, long-context workloads rather than graphics performance.

headline: Hackers Turn Supermarket Fridges Into Ovens
lede: A suspected attack forced connected refrigeration systems into repeated 50°C defrost cycles, threatening food stocks across European supermarkets. Websites, deliveries, prices, and loyalty systems were also disrupted, though the incidents have not all been tied to one cause.

headline: A Modern Web App Ships as One C Binary
lede: Build the service in C. Serve it with OpenBSD httpd, CGI, SQLite, and a statically linked binary. The result trades framework convention for inspectable deployment, while accepting the security and maintenance work that the stack leaves to the builder.

headline: A Second Model Checks the First
lede: Unsiloed extracts document values with confidence scores and page references; TypeSafe Jev then tests focused questions of plausibility without seeing the source image. The example puts one medication-list check at a fraction of a cent while preserving the trail for human review.

headline: A Regulator Was Told to Drop the Trail
lede: CFTC staff were reportedly instructed to retract analysis of trades placed minutes before a presidential announcement moved oil and equities. The episode leaves a quiet but consequential question in the dark: who knew what, and who was allowed to investigate it?
